new_facts_from_search: 2026-01: Devli bought 100 Leyland Dr, Leonia (37,000 SF, 24 ft clear, 4 docks, 2 drive-ins; Aboudi Realty brokered; Provident Bank financed; price undisclosed) - the pack's undated Leonia row is a 2026 deal, not 2019-2024 (https://re-nj.com/devli-real-estate-adds-37000-sq-ft-industrial-building-in-leonia/ ; https://nyrej.com/devli-real-estate-acquires-37000-sf-industrial-at-100-leyland-dr-in-leonia-nj)

2026-04/06: Devli bought 116-118 Route 17 N, Upper Saddle River, 67,000 SF three-building flex industrial/retail on 6.3 ac with 19 drive-ins and IOS potential; price undisclosed (https://re-nj.com/devli-acquires-67000-sq-ft-industrial-retail-portfolio-on-route-17-in-upper-saddle-river/ ; https://rebusinessonline.com/devli-real-estate-buys-67000-sf-industrial-flex-building-in-upper-saddle-river-new-jersey/)

Stated 2026 strategy quote from principal Christopher Devli: the Upper Saddle River buy 'advances our strategy of pursuing infill industrial and flex assets in supply-constrained Northeast submarkets' (https://nyrej.com/devli-real-estate-acquires-67000-sf-flex-industrial-property-on-rte-17-in-upper-saddle-river)

Carlstadt 4-acre assemblage (125 & 335 Paterson Plank Rd, 111 Twentieth St) dates to approx. 2023-06; three undisclosed sellers; CBRE (D'Amato, Babikian) and Team Resources (Rosenberg, Sholom) brokered; Mark Devli quoted as CIO, confirming the pack's 'unverifiable' title (https://re-nj.com/devli-completes-four-acre-assemblage-in-meadowlands-after-three-industrial-deals/)

Warren flex deal is pre-window: 150 Mt. Bethel Rd, Warren, 121,954 SF on 15.7 ac from The Hampshire Cos., approx. 2018-01, 88% leased, C&W brokered, price undisclosed - excluded from 2019-2024 table (https://www.connectcre.com/stories/devli-group-buys-hackettstown-commerce-park-in-warren-county-nj/ ; https://www.commercialsearch.com/news/devli-group-continues-acquisition-binge-in-nj/)
No 2025 NJ acquisition by Devli found on re-nj.com, roi-nj.com or njbiz.com (https://re-nj.com/tag/devli-real-estate/)
devli.com publishes no team/leadership page; names come only from press quotes (https://devli.com/company ; https://devli.com/acquisitions)

Correction: the 195,000 SF two-building New Brunswick industrial development (Joyce Kilmer Logistics Center) is a Faropoint + Deugen Development project, not Devli; a search summary had conflated it, so it was excluded as a Devli fact (https://re-nj.com/faropoint-deugen-eye-groundbreaking-for-195000-sq-ft-warehouse-project-in-new-brunswick/)

2025-04: bought 745 Gotham Pkwy, Carlstadt - 31,472 SF, 19' clear, ~1.5 ac, private seller, Resource Realty on both sides, price undisclosed; 15th Meadowlands investment; NJ portfolio now 6.3M+ SF / 40 properties (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/seagis-property-group-acquires-31-000-sf-industrial-building-in-northern-new-jersey-302441522.html; https://re-nj.com/seagis-buys-31000-sq-ft-carlstadt-warehouse-as-its-latest-meadowlands-property/)

No 2026 NJ acquisition found; 2026 NJ activity is a 182,000 SF lease at 100 Milik St, Carteret (https://www.seagisproperty.com/seagis-property-group-leases-182000-square-foot-building-in-carteret-nj/) and a 53,315 SF build-to-suit at 500 Belleville Tpke, Kearny/North Arlington due summer 2026 (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/seagis-property-group-commences-construction-on-a-53-000-square-foot-build-to-suit-in-north-arlington-nj-302645024.html)

2026 acquisitions were out of state: Medley, FL 200,000 SF (2026-03) and Sunset Park, Brooklyn 15,000 SF (2026-07) (https://www.seagisproperty.com/seagis-property-group-acquires-200000-square-foot-building-in-medley-fl/; https://www.seagisproperty.com/seagis-property-group-acquires-15000-square-foot-building-in-brooklyn-ny/)
$176M refinancing of a 1.22M SF NJ/FL warehouse portfolio reported in 2026; no leadership or strategy change reported (https://re-nj.com/tag/seagis-property-group/)

Tyler Baker is Senior Vice President as of 2025-04 (Vice President in 2022-2024 releases), based in Seagis's Northern NJ office and quoted on every NJ acquisition release 2022-2025 - closest public match to a NJ acquisitions lead (https://www.seagisproperty.com/seagis-property-group-acquires-31000-sf-industrial-building-in-northern-new-jersey/; https://www.seagisproperty.com/seagis-property-group-acquires-211000-sf-new-development-in-kearny-nj/)

Erin Plourde named Chief Investment Officer 2023-02, joined 2020 after 16 years at Liberty Property Trust; John Begier confirmed as CEO on the company's own release (https://www.seagisproperty.com/seagis-property-group-names-erin-plourde-chief-investment-officer/)
Omer Mir Ahmed named Chief Development Officer 2024-02, leads a $300M development pipeline (https://www.seagisproperty.com/seagis-property-group-names-omer-mir-ahmed-chief-development-officer/)

NJ office is in East Rutherford per a 2024 release (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/seagis-property-group-leases-202-000-square-foot-building-in-east-rutherford-nj-302179313.html); LinkedIn lists 160 Chubb Avenue, Suite 104, Lyndhurst, NJ 07071 - unconfirmed (https://www.linkedin.com/company/seagis-property-group-lp)

936 Harrison Ave, Kearny price was not disclosed (closing 2024-10-28 per traded.co); the pack's $21.0M figure is unverified (https://rebusinessonline.com/cushman-wakefield-brokers-sale-of-211287-sf-warehouse-in-kearny-new-jersey/)

333 Veterans Blvd (19,974 SF, Resource Realty brokered) and 25 Amor Ave (30,058 SF) in Carlstadt were both vacant at purchase, bought to upgrade and lease (https://re-nj.com/seagis-adds-20000-sq-ft-carlstadt-warehouse-in-resource-realty-brokered-deal/; https://re-nj.com/seagis-acquires-vacant-30000-sq-ft-warehouse-in-carlstadt/)

Read Mortimer promoted 2025-04 to SVP, Investment Officer - New Jersey, overseeing all capital deployment in the region; joined 2022-07 as Lehigh Valley investment officer; ex-Rubenstein Partners and Starwood (https://www.roi-nj.com/2025/04/10/real_estate/prologis-promotes-read-mortimer-to-senior-vice-president-of-nj-region/; https://commercialobserver.com/2025/04/prologis-promotes-read-mortimer-nj-investments/)

Mike Sacro is SVP, Market Officer NY/NJ, leading a 246-building ~55M SF regional portfolio; appointed 2021 after seven years running Central Florida, succeeding Jesse Harty (https://re-nj.com/prologis-taps-sacro-as-market-leader-for-new-york-new-jersey/)

Prologis ranked No. 1 on NJBIZ's 2026 NJ commercial real estate developers list with 53.4M SF owned or controlled; Sacro leads the operation (https://njbiz.com/prologis-leads-njbiz-2026-commercial-real-estate-developers/)

DATE CONFLICT: the pack dates the 201 Middlesex Center Blvd / 773 Cranbury South River Rd Exit 8A pair ($197.4M) as 2023, but traded.co lists closing 2025-03-31 with seller ARC Realty and price $166.8M for 201 Middlesex Center Blvd, Realgraph lists 2025-04-22, and CRE Daily calls it the largest Q1 2025 NJ industrial trade (https://traded.co/deals/new-jersey/industrial/sale/201-middlesex-center-boulevard/; https://realgraph.co/buildings/201-middlesex-center-blvd-monroe-township-nj-08831; https://www.credaily.com/briefs/industrial-sales-boom-in-new-jersey/)

2025-08: Prologis closed on ~200 acres in East Greenwich, Gloucester County, for a three-building 826,000 SF industrial park (https://re-nj.com/prologis-plans-three-building-826000-sq-ft-industrial-park-for-latest-east-greenwich-project/)

Prologis is building a 379,000 SF Bergen County warehouse for early-2027 delivery; Mortimer quoted calling NJ one of the East Coast's most important logistics hubs (https://re-nj.com/prologis-eyes-early-2027-delivery-for-new-379000-sq-ft-bergen-county-warehouse/)

2026: Prologis delivered a ~437,000 SF warehouse at 395 Elizabeth Ave, Somerset (Franklin Twp) and owns nearly 56M SF in NJ; no 2026 NJ acquisition found in public sources (https://re-nj.com/prologis-completes-new-437000-sq-ft-warehouse-in-i-287-corridor/)

Q2 2026 results: $1.8B of third-party acquisitions 'at attractive discounts to replacement cost', $1.6B of development starts across logistics and data centers, acquisition guidance (Prologis share) reported raised to $1.5-2.0B from $1.0-1.5B, data center power pipeline 5.8 GW - table column order should be verified against the release (https://www.prologis.com/insights-news/press-releases/prologis-reports-second-quarter-2026-results)

2025-06: Faropoint paid $328M for a 30-building five-state Mapletree portfolio including five NJ buildings (270,517 SF) at 100-400 Forge Way, Rockaway and 321 Richard Mine Rd, Wharton - its largest deal to date (https://re-nj.com/mapletree-sells-u-s-industrial-portfolio-including-270000-sq-ft-in-morris-county-in-328-million-deal-with-faropoint/)

2025-09: bought 5 Vreeland Rd, Florham Park, 50,600 SF, for $9.25M from the Ilaria Family Trust via CBRE (https://www.roi-nj.com/2025/09/09/real_estate_development/faropoint-buys-industrial-facility-from-the-ilaria-family-trust-for-9-25m/)

2026-04: bought 200 & 300 Roundhill Dr, Rockaway, two fully leased shallow-bay buildings, ~72,908 SF, from North Jersey Development Group (https://njbiz.com/faropoint-rockaway-morris-county-shallow-bay-industrial/)

Industrial Value Fund IV launched 2025-06 targeting $1B with $225M seed from Teacher Retirement System of Texas; strategy is mark-to-market plus lease-up and a development sleeve, 200-250 assets of 20,000-100,000 SF (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250625536421/en/Faropoint-Launches-Flagship-Industrial-Value-Fund-IV-Targeting-$1-Billion)
2026-01: $600M acquisition credit facility secured for Fund IV (https://www.roi-nj.com/2026/01/08/finance/faropoint-announces-600m-acquisition-credit-facility-secured-for-industrial-value-fund-iv/)

By 2026-02 Fund IV had deployed ~$284M across 30 properties / 1.72M SF; APG made the largest commitment (https://news.smallbaylist.com/p/february-24-apg-makes-largest-commitment-faropoin-industrial-value-fund)

Fund III closed at $915M in 2024-06, above its $750M target (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240626350875/en/Faropoint-Closes-Flagship-Urban-Industrial-Value-Fund-III-with-%24915-Million-Exceeding-Target-Fund-Size-and-Attracting-Top-Tier-Global-Investors)

2021-12 Kushner portfolio sourced: 10 buildings, 654,633 SF, 98% leased, Whippany/Oakland/Fair Lawn, $132.5M, JLL seller rep, KeyBank revolver; Ohad Porat quoted as CIO (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20211222005173/en/Faropoint-Acquires-10-Building-Last-Mile-Portfolio-In-Northern-New-Jersey-From-Kushner-Cos.-For-$132.5M)

2023-11: Invesco Real Estate took an undisclosed minority stake in the Faropoint platform; Adir Levitas confirmed as Founder & CEO (https://roi-nj.com/2023/11/29/real_estate/faropoint-secures-strategic-investment-from-invesco-real-estate)

Itay Ron is SVP Northeast Markets (2023 Branchburg release) and listed as MD, Northeast Market Officer on faropoint.com - the NJ regional lead (https://www.roi-nj.com/2023/01/30/real_estate_development/faropoint-acquires-industrial-property-in-branchburg-for-23-75m/; https://www.faropoint.com/)

Faropoint now develops in NJ: 195,000 SF New Brunswick project with Deugen on a $33M loan, and a 74,000 SF Cumberland County project site (https://re-nj.com/faropoint-deugen-ink-33-million-loan-for-195000-sq-ft-new-brunswick-warehouse-project/; https://re-nj.com/faropoint-eyes-74000-sq-ft-warehouse-project-at-newly-acquired-site-in-cumberland-county/)

2026-08 Connecticut deed lists buyer c/o Faropoint Ventures LLC, corroborating the c/o address pattern for tax bills (https://hartfordbusiness.com/article/stratford-warehouse-sells-4-5-million-faropoint/)
